layman_headline: Solana trade is working — up 4% and climbing toward our target, but no new compelling trades today.
layman_explanation: Our Solana position is performing well, up about 4% since we bought in, riding a strong 12.7% weekly rally. The broader crypto market is in a 'Greed' zone but cooling slightly from yesterday. The candidates on our watchlist are either stablecoins (no trade opportunity), overbought (PUMP with RSI 84), or lack sufficient technical data to build a confident setup. Bitcoin dominance at 59% continues to suppress most altcoins, making it a tough environment for new alt entries.
layman_action: Hold your current Solana position and let it work toward the $115 target. Don't chase anything new right now — the available setups are weak. Keep your stop-loss at $92 and be patient.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is exceptionally weak this cycle. PUMP has an RSI of 84 — deeply overbought and a high-risk entry. JTO is down 91.7% from ATH and 17.8% on the week with no technical data to confirm a bottom — classic falling knife. MON lacks any technical indicators. The remaining candidates are stablecoins or gold-pegged tokens with zero swing potential. SOL continues to build on its breakout with the disinflation vote providing a fundamental tailwind. At $105.14, we're 4.1% in profit with a clear path to the $115 exit target (~9.4% more upside). BTC dominance at 59% and F&G cooling from 73 to 68 warrant caution on new alt entries.

SOL is already up 12.7% on the week and may be due for a consolidation or pullback
High BTC dominance (59%) continues to pressure altcoin performance broadly
watch_list: SOL price action near $110 resistance — if it stalls, consider tightening stop to $98
Bitcoin ETF flow data — resumption of inflows would support broader market including SOL

market_context: The crypto market is in a mild 'Greed' phase that's cooling slightly (68 from 73 yesterday). BTC dominance remains elevated at 59%, creating headwinds for most altcoins except those with strong individual catalysts like SOL.
context_banner: Solana leads altcoin recovery on disinflation catalyst while weak candidate pool argues for patience over new entries.
